Agent1 sometimes change to another language.
evidence:
[note] Root cause: the harness is English end to end (system prompt, tool schemas, tool results, logs) and the only language instruction was one clause at the end of a long rules list, so after long English tool loops the model drifted to English and answered non-English users in English. Fixed: agent_core/language.py is now the single owner of the reply-language policy - deterministic best-effort detector (script evidence first, then function-word markers; ties and one-marker cases stay inconclusive) plus the AGENT1_LANGUAGE override. The per-turn reminder is appended LAST in the system message on both rebuild paths, closest to the conversation, and run_utils.strip_dynamic_system_blocks cuts it at LANGUAGE_MARKER so exactly one copy exists per rebuild. English or undecidable turns add nothing: the prompt stays byte-identical to the baseline. Regression tests in tests/test_response_language.py.
[note] Language-drift fix landed and is contract-tested. agent_core/language.py is the single owner of reply-language policy; AGENT1_LANGUAGE is read live from os.environ at prompt-build time so it is always communicated to every LLM turn; the per-turn block is rebuilt last and stripped on rebuild (never accumulates). tests/test_response_language.py (34 tests) is green.

title: Communicating current shell.
evidence: [note] Root cause: the prompt advertised one shell while execution used another. On Windows subprocess shell=True always runs %ComSpec% (cmd.exe), so a model told SHELL_NAME=powershell and following that prompt with PowerShell cmdlets was executed by cmd.exe, which does not know them; the failure looked like a broken hint. Fixed: agent_core/shell_utils.py has ONE detect_shell() whose answer both the prompt text and run_shell_command's argv use - the advertised shell and the executing shell are now one. Commands reach the shell in list form as a single argument (the old bare [command] with shell=False was not executable, CreateProcess parsed the whole string as one program name), PowerShell gets the statement-list adaptations (call-operator rewrite, UTF-8 console pinning, __AGENT1_EXIT__ exit-code marker recovery), and AGENT1_SHELL=none/off/raw/default is the documented escape hatch that skips the wrapper. The REPL prompt now names the active shell. Regression tests in tests/test_shell_communication.py.

title: Jev strategy layer: escalation strategies for jev_decide (cascade, triage, verify)
evidence: [note] Card asked for a strategy layer on top of the jev_decide decision engine. Added agent_core/jev_strategy.py: cheap-first decision policies that map typed engine results to ACCEPT/ESCALATE verdicts - cascade_decide (accept when the probability reaches the threshold, escalate with a reason otherwise), triage (choose among options, re-asked with the order swapped as a position-bias guard, escalates when the winner moves), verify_answer (yesno judge of the draft answer in state against the task), plus an escalation ladder (run_ladder) that stops at the first accept. Wired into the jev_decide tool as a new 'strategy' parameter (agent_core/handlers/nlp_tools.py:_nlp_jev_decide), advertised in the tool schema (agent_core/tool_schemas.py) and taught in the system prompt (agent_core/shell_utils.py). 38 regression tests in tests/test_jev_strategy.py.
